# Allan Hvolby

Allan Hvolby is a specialist physician (speciallæge) in child and adolescent psychiatry (Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatri) in Denmark [^src1][^src2]. He is named as a member of the steering group (styregruppe) for the ADHD-databasen, a Danish national health-quality database that monitors the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2].

He appears in listings of the database's steering group in the ADHD-database's 2023 annual report [^src1] and again in the 2024 report, where his professional affiliation is additionally listed as the Forening af praktiserende speciallæger (Association of Practicing Specialist Physicians) [^src2]. The steering group he belongs to is described in the surrounding documentation as drawing together senior consultants, specialist physicians, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relative/patient representatives from across Denmark's five regions, alongside professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src2]. This body oversees the database's monitoring of ADHD diagnostic and treatment pathways for children, adolescents, and, in later reporting periods, adults, including regional variations and demographic breakdowns of the patient population [^src2].

No relationships, claims, or timeline events beyond his steering-group membership and professional titles are recorded in the available data.
